rules.name: Scroll of the Pearl Throne
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: Round of Combat. 
Choose a Magic Item from an enemy unit that is in contact with the bearer. This Magic Item is ignored. 
 Note: If it was an Enchanted Weapon or Enchanted Shield, the mundane effects of the Weapon or Shield can still be used.

If the wearer Miscasts and suffers Witchfire, the number of hits are halved (rounding fractions up) for the wearer and its unit.

In addition, Rank-and-File model parts with Elf in the unit gain Devastating Charge(+1 Str).

rules.description:
Devastating Charge (+1 Att), Lethal Strike, Divine Attacks. 
 One use only. May be used during Combat Choices: the wielder counts as Charging for the purpose of Devastating Charge, with Duration: Round of Combat.

rules.description:
+1 Str, +2 AP. 
Each successful to-hit roll with this weapon causes two hits instead of one.

rules.name: Cadaron's Heartwood
rules.description: Shots 3, Str as user +1, AP as user +1.

rules.name: Book of Meladys
rules.description: The first time in each Magic Phase that the bearer fails a Casting Roll for a Learned Spell cast with three Magic Dice, the bearer may reroll all Magic Dice.

rules.name: Diadem of Protection
rules.description: Aegis (+2, max 4+).

rules.name: Amethyst Crystal
rules.description: Unless the bearer is Shaken, Dispelling Rolls made by the bearer’s army gain a +1 modifier; if the target of an enemy spell is within 18" of the bearer, that modifier is increased to +2.

rules.name: Asfad Scholar
rules.description:
The model gains Channel (1). 
 The Range of the Wizard’s Learned Spells is increased by 6". 
Aura spells gain +3" Range instead, while spells with type Caster are unaffected.

rules.name: Order of the Fiery Heart
rules.description:
The model gains Flaming Attacks, Metal Armour, and the model part’s Armour is set to 2. 
 The model replaces its available Paths of Magic with Alchemy, Pyromancy, and ignores the Missile, Damage spell Types for Learned Spells when targeting units that are Engaged in Combat with itself.

rules.name: Master of Canreig Tower
rules.description:
The model gains Master of Spellcrafting, Wizard Conclave (3). 

 The model has these spells available: Living Steel, Altered Sight, Fountain of Youth, Whispers of the Veil, Predator’s Instinct, Mind Fog, Favour of Meladys.

rules.name: High Warden of the Flame
rules.description: The model gains Aegis (4+), Fearless, Stubborn.

rules.name: Fleet Officer
rules.description:
The model gains Strider (Water Terrain), Resolute. 
 If the models unit contains a model that already has Resolute from another source, the unit is considered to have two additional Proper Ranks instead of one. 
The bearer also gains Lightning Attacks and, if using a Longbow, Stand and Shoot.

rules.name: Grandmaster of the Sword
rules.description:
The model gains First Strike (+1 Def, +1 Off), Sword Sworn. 
While joined to a unit containing Sword Masters, the model's unit benefits from +1 Agi.

rules.name: Royal Huntsman
rules.description:
The model must take Great Weapon and cannot take Shield. 
 The model gains Lion’s Fur, Valiant, and the bearer gains Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 4--5). 
While joined to a unit containing Lion Guards, the model's unit benefits from Swiftstride.

rules.name: Queen's Cavalier
rules.description:
The bearer gains First Strike (+1 Att, +1 Off) and the bearers unit may reroll failed Charge Range rolls. 

 If the model has Height 5, Regal Dragons and Ancient Dragons replace their Ancient Allies (2) rule with Ancient Allies (1), and Phoenixes replace Ancient Allies (1) with Ancient Allies (2).

rules.name: Queen's Companion
rules.description: The model’s Longbow Shots are set to 3, and the model’s unit gains Accurate.

sharedRules.name: Rebirth
sharedRules.description:
When the model loses its last Health Point, unless it is a Summoned model, the owner must roll a D6. On a 5+, it is a success — apply the following effects: 
 • Before removing the model as a casualty, mark the centre of its final position. 
 • At the start of the next friendly Movement Phase, Summon a new Phoenix within 3" of the marked point. 
 The Summoned model has the same upgrades as the original Phoenix. 
Immediately after being Deployed, the model loses 4 Health Points, which cannot be prevented nor Recovered in any way. 
 If the roll is failed, the model is removed as a casualty as normal.

sharedRules.name: Fire Phoenix
sharedRules.description:
The Phoenix model part gains Flaming Attacks,Grind Attack (D6, Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks, Unmodifiable), Sweeping Attack (XD3*+1, Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks). 
 * X is the number of Ranks in the target unit.

sharedRules.name: Fae Miasma
sharedRules.description:
Can only be used with Longbows and Paired Weapons.
When a unit suffers one or more wounds from attacks with Fae Miasma (before any saves are taken), all models in the unit suffer a -1 to-hit modifier (both for Shooting Attacks and Melee Attacks), with Duration: One Turn.

sharedRules.name: Moonlight Arrows
sharedRules.description:
Can only be used with Longbows without Weapon Enchantments.
The attack gains Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks, and its Strength is set to 4.

sharedRules.name: Sword Sworn
sharedRules.description: Standard Melee Attacks with a Great Weapon ignore Distracting, Parry.

sharedRules.name: Dragonforged Armour

sharedRules.name: Lion’s Fur
sharedRules.description: If the model is without Mount, it gains +1 Arm, which is improved to +2 Arm against Shooting Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Favour of Meladys
sharedRules.description:
=1pt The target gains two Protection Tokens, which are removed when the spell ends. When a friendly unit within 18" of the target suffers a wound, after Armour Saves have been taken, but before any Special Saves are taken, the target may discard a Protection Token and ignore the wound applying the following rules: 
 • Rank-and-File models of Height 1 ignore up to two wounds per token (provided they are suffered simultaneously). 
 • Characters, and models of Height 4 or 5, can each only ignore a single wound per phase. 
 • Wounds from attacks with Multiple Wounds are not ignored: they inflict one less wound instead.
